items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: Grauer. Grauer issued it later. ... I don't think I have any of his.

ctx.x: No, it was Frog Eye Moore. What's his name issued it later? Grauer. Grauer issued it later. Oh, he did. Yes. I, the role might have made it. I don't know. I don't think I have any of his. I'm pretty sure I haven't.
No, there's the, uh, somewhere in here, these Vali DeVoe things, I can't remember. He was on some, wasn't he? Yeah, there was a trio, uh.
